research.finding: Haralick and Elliott motivate fail-first ordering and forward checking to prevent inconsistent partial assignments from expanding into repeated tree search.
Exact routing feasibility can be expressed as interacting simultaneous resource assignments; late independent checks lose the benefit of shared constraints.
TritonRoute integrates connectivity and design-rule constraints into detailed search and repair rather than treating post-route DRC counts as routability.

next_experiment.change: Add deterministic forward checking for pairwise access support and adjacent-run layer continuity to generate_consistent_bundle_choices, with diagnostic prune counters.
